_comment: Item 5 corner envelope, spec row 11 (loop power excluding the VCO core), stage 2 of the spec C-grid.
Circuit: CML prescaler + M/A divider at N = 100 driven at 5.0 GHz (design/netlist/{prescaler,divider}.spice). PFD + CP + bias, lock detector, reference and clock buffering are NOT in this circuit.
Per corner: ipavg / idavg = mean supply current of each rail over 40n-120n; tfb = 3 FB periods (rise 1 to rise 4 after 40n); 3 x 19.5-20.5 ns means the divider divides to 50 MHz.
Power limits are NOT set on the requests: the 20 mW budget needs PFD+CP+bias added and the owed blocks; the record grades it.
Issue #97 probed forced-state trial, TYP 125 C 2.97 V, same forcing and probes as the SLOW run.
